Title: Arbitrum One mainnet opens to all users
Detail: Offchain Labs launched the Arbitrum One mainnet so the public could interact with apps on it. ETHBEAT dates the whitelist removal to the same day

Title: Offchain Labs raises $120M Series B
Detail: Led by Lightspeed Venture Partners at a $1.2B valuation, announced alongside the Arbitrum One public launch

Title: Odyssey campaign paused after heavy load
Detail: ETHBEAT lists the Arbitrum Odyssey campaign, started on Jun 21 2022, as paused on Jun 29 2022 because of heavy network load

Title: Arbitrum Nova goes live
Detail: Arbitrum Nova, a separate chain for gaming and social apps built on the Nitro stack, went live and hosts Reddit community points

Title: Arbitrum One migrates to Nitro
Detail: Arbitrum One moved to the Nitro stack, which uses calldata compression and closer EVM compatibility to lower fees and raise capacity

Title: ARB airdrop and Arbitrum DAO launch
Detail: ARB claims opened with 1.16B ARB, or 11.6% of supply, for early users and 113M ARB for ecosystem DAOs. ARB holders govern Arbitrum One and Nova through a self executing DAO

Title: Ostium raises $3.5M seed
Detail: Backed by General Catalyst, LocalGlobe, SIG, Balaji Srinivasan and AllianceDAO

Title: Rho Protocol raises $2.2M pre-seed
Detail: Backed by Speedinvest, KeyRock, Re7 Capital, Daedalus and Dmitry Tokarev

Title: Arbitrum One outage during inscriptions surge
Detail: A sustained surge of inscriptions caused the sequencer to stop relaying transactions properly. The outage lasted about an hour and a half before all systems were reported operational

Title: Dinari raises $10M seed plus
Detail: Backed by 500 Global, Balaji Srinivasan, Alchemy, Version One Ventures and Sancus Ventures

Title: Arbitrum starts posting data to blobs
Detail: ETHBEAT dates the switch to posting Arbitrum One transaction data to Ethereum blobs to Mar 14 2024

Title: Entropy Advisors starts first DAO service term
Amount Note: Year 1 target funded by selling 6M ARB
Detail: Entropy Advisors began a 12 month exclusive service term for the Arbitrum DAO that ended on Aug 31 2025

Title: Stylus goes live on Arbitrum One and Nova
Detail: Stylus lets developers write contracts in languages that compile to WebAssembly, such as Rust, alongside the EVM. It launched on the third anniversary of Arbitrum One

Title: ArbOS 32 emergency upgrade fixes Stylus pricing
Detail: ETHBEAT lists an ArbOS 32 emergency upgrade on Sep 25 2024 that fixed Stylus resource pricing

Title: Variational raises $10.3M seed
Amount Note: Priced equity with token warrants, closed Dec 2021
Detail: Led by Bain Capital Crypto and Peak XV Partners with Coinbase Ventures, Dragonfly, North Island Ventures and Hack VC

Title: Exit window extended to 7 days
Detail: The L2 timelock was extended to 8 days, giving users a 7 day exit window before regular upgrades take effect

Title: Bleap raises $2.3M pre-seed
Detail: Backed by Ethereal Ventures, Maven 11, AllianceDAO, Robot Ventures and Credibly Neutral

Title: Tandem invests in Camelot
Detail: Tandem, the venture arm linked to Offchain Labs, invested in Camelot, a native Arbitrum DEX that had been community bootstrapped without venture funding

Title: Rho Protocol raises $4M seed
Detail: Backed by CoinFund, Flow Traders, Auros Global and Speedinvest

Title: BoLD permissionless validation goes live
Detail: Following a governance vote, BoLD replaced allow listed validators on Arbitrum One and Nova so anyone can validate and challenge assertions, with disputes bounded at about 12 days

Title: Abracadabra loses $13M in liquidation exploit
Detail: A flash loan attack on cauldrons that accept GMX V2 LP tokens as collateral manipulated liquidation logic to self liquidate and extract incentives. DefiLlama lists Arbitrum only

Title: Timeboost transaction ordering introduced
Detail: ETHBEAT lists the Timeboost ordering policy as introduced on Arbitrum One on Apr 29 2025

Title: Dinari raises $12.7M Series A
Detail: Backed by Hack VC, Blockchange Ventures, Arete Capital, Blizzard Fund, Factor Capital, F-Prime Capital, GSR, VanEck and Silvermine

Title: Arbitrum Gaming Ventures names first cohort
Projects: Arbitrum Gaming Ventures;Wildcard;Hyve Labs;T-Rex;Xai;Proof of Play
Detail: Arbitrum Gaming Ventures, formerly the Gaming Catalyst Program, introduced its first investment cohort of Wildcard, Hyve Labs, T-Rex, Xai and Proof of Play

Title: Variational raises $1.5M strategic round
Detail: Backed by Mirana Ventures, Caladan and Zoku Ventures with other undisclosed partners

Title: ArbOS 40 Callisto upgrade
Detail: ETHBEAT lists the ArbOS 40 Callisto upgrade on Arbitrum One on Jun 18 2025

Title: Vertex winds down its Arbitrum DEX
Detail: Vertex said it would wind down its EVM deployments, sunset the VRTX token and rebuild exclusively on Ink, with the Ink Foundation absorbing its team and trading stack

Title: GMX V1 loses $42M to reentrancy
Detail: An attacker reentered executeDecreaseOrder in GMX V1 on Arbitrum to manipulate short positions and inflate the GLP price. Funds were returned on Jul 12 minus a $5M bounty

Title: Arbitrum Audit Program launches
Detail: The Foundation opened a $10M program of grants and investments that subsidizes third party smart contract audits for teams building on Arbitrum

Title: USD.AI raises $13M Series A
Detail: Led by Framework Ventures with Dragonfly, Arbitrum, Big Brain Holdings, CMT Digital, Hermeneutic Investments, FWL Capital and Flowdesk

Title: DRIP Season 1 starts
Detail: DRIP Season 1 pays ARB to users who borrow against yield bearing ETH and stablecoin assets on Arbitrum One, with rewards claimed through Merkl

Title: USD.AI raises $4M from Bullish
Detail: Strategic investment from Bullish

Title: UXLINK multisig exploited for $11.3M
Detail: An attacker used a delegatecall in the UXLINK multisig to rewrite the owner set, drained about $11.3M and minted more UXLINK tokens. DefiLlama lists Ethereum and Arbitrum

Title: Garden solver compromise drains $11.4M
Detail: One of Garden Finance's solvers was compromised, letting an attacker drain funds across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base and Solana

Title: Balancer V2 loses $128M to rounding exploit
Detail: A rounding flaw in batchSwap invariant calculations drained Balancer V2 Composable Stable Pools across six chains including Arbitrum

Title: USD.AI backed by Coinbase Ventures
Detail: Investment from Coinbase Ventures

Title: Enlivex commits $212M to RAIN tokens
Amount Note: Corporate token treasury, not a raise
Detail: Nasdaq listed Enlivex said it would buy $212M of RAIN, the token of the Rain prediction market protocol on Arbitrum, funded by a share sale

Title: Reya raises $3M in a public token sale
Detail: Public token sale

Title: Ostium raises $20M Series A
Detail: Backed by General Catalyst, Jump Trading, Coinbase Ventures, Wintermute Ventures and GSR

Title: Ostium raises $4M strategic round
Detail: Strategic round recorded alongside the Series A

Title: ArbOS 51 Dia activates
Detail: ArbOS 51 Dia activated on Arbitrum One and Nova after a Dec 18 2025 vote, adding Fusaka EVM changes, higher gas targets and a higher minimum L2 base fee

Title: Bleap raises $6M seed
Detail: Backed by Blossom Capital

Title: DRIP Season 1 ends
Amount Note: About 16.7M ARB of the 24M ARB budget used
Detail: Season 1 closed with Epoch 12, four weeks after its planned end. Incentives were paused with Season 2 targeted for mid to late April 2026

Title: Open House NYC buildathon winners
Detail: Tilt Protocol won $15K, Fangorn $10K and EqualFi $5K. The buildathon drew 512 builders from more than 40 countries

Title: Robinhood Chain commits $1M to Open House 2026
Detail: Robinhood committed $1M to Open House 2026 to help fund early stage builders

Title: Arbitrum Mentorship Program opens applications
Detail: An eight week equity free program with ecosystem mentors and a Demo Day for investors. Applications closed on Apr 7 2026

Title: Carbon moves its perp DEX from Base to Arbitrum
Detail: The Arbitrum Foundation newsletter reported that Carbon moved to Arbitrum for its 250ms blocks and is launching Carbon Solver, its CLP and a Momentum Program there

Title: NYC Founder House awards $340K
Detail: Kustodia won $60K, Laytus $40K and EqualFi $20K, with the top three prizes sponsored by the Arbitrum Foundation and Robinhood Chain. Robinhood Chain fully sponsored $50K for Bond.Credit and $100K Founder in Residence funding for Tilt Protocol

Title: Golden Tides raises $3.5M
Detail: Krafton led the round for the pirate MOBA Golden Tides, with FlyQuest and Arbitrum Gaming Ventures

Title: Kelp rsETH bridge exploited for $293M
Detail: Attackers injected fraudulent cross chain messages after compromising LayerZero RPC nodes, exploiting a 1 of 1 verifier setup. DefiLlama lists Ethereum and Arbitrum

Title: Security Council recovers Kelp exploit funds
Detail: ETHBEAT records a Security Council action to recover funds stolen in the Kelp rsETH bridge exploit and puts the recovered amount at about 30,766 ETH

Title: Variational raises $50M Series A
Detail: Led by Dragonfly with Bain Capital Crypto and Coinbase Ventures to bring over 100 TradFi markets online and release the Omni app

Title: Bridge emergency upgrade patches governance issue
Detail: ETHBEAT lists a bridge emergency upgrade that patched a governance denial of service issue and states no funds were at risk

Title: Open House London buildathon ends
Detail: The online buildathon ran from May 25 to Jun 14 with 782 builders. Verus won $40K, Capricorn $20K and Denaria $10K, and the agentic track went to ReineiraOS, AlphaGrid and Pact Network

Title: Robinhood Chain mainnet goes live
Detail: Robinhood Chain launched as a dedicated chain built with the Arbitrum Platform, following Robinhood Classic Stock Tokens that launched on Arbitrum One in 2025

Title: Mentorship Program cohort 1 Demo Day
Amount Note: Split across four winners, shares not stated
Detail: Ten of 13 selected teams reached Demo Day and Carbon, LayerV, T3tris and Capa won. Five cohort teams launched on Robinhood Chain testnet or mainnet

Title: London Founder House awards $300K
Projects: Arbitrum Open House;Liquida;The Risk Protocol;EdenFi;Obolos;Saffron;Agama Finance;AlphaGrid;CanHav Research;ReineiraOS;Robinhood Chain
Amount Note: Includes $70K committed to teams that keep making progress
Detail: Liquida won $60K and The Risk Protocol $40K, with EdenFi and Obolos sharing $20K. Robinhood Chain awards went to Saffron with $60K and Agama Finance with $30K

Title: Ostium loses $23.75M after oracle key compromise
Detail: An attacker used a compromised price oracle key to sign false Bitcoin prices, opening positions at fake prices and closing at market rates. DefiLlama lists Arbitrum only

Title: AFX Bridge drained of $24.15M
Detail: An attacker obtained 5 of 7 validator keys for the AFX Trade Arbitrum bridge, passed the multisig threshold and drained USDC. AFX offered a 30% recovery bounty

Title: Arbitrum Security Program proposed
Amount Note: Funded from remaining program funds, no new treasury request
Detail: The Foundation proposed evolving the Audit Program into a Security Program for 12 more months, adding AI assisted screening, the bug bounty and Security Council support

Title: ArbOS 61 Elara activates
Detail: ArbOS 61 Elara activated on Arbitrum One and Nova, raising the Stylus contract size limit to 96 KB. Compliance filtering ships but is disabled on Arbitrum One and Nova

Title: Offchain Labs shows ZK proving inside BoLD
Detail: BoLD can now confirm an assertion once a valid ZK proof and a Fast Confirmation Committee agree, which could cut settlement from days to hours. ZK is additive and a DAO proposal is still needed for Arbitrum One

Title: Antarctic raises $7M
Detail: Backed by Valisa Capital Markets, Republic Crypto and Lucidity Capital

Title: Open House Singapore buildathon starts
Detail: A three week online buildathon for teams bringing finance ideas onchain, backed by the Robinhood Chain commitment to Open House

Title: Priority Gas Auctions replace Timeboost
Detail: ETHBEAT lists Timeboost as replaced by Priority Gas Auctions on Arbitrum One on Sep 23 2026

Title: Arbitrum Security Program launches
Detail: The Security Program offers audit subsidies to testnet and mainnet projects, teams migrating from other chains and dedicated Arbitrum chains

Title: Security Council pauses new Stylus activations
Detail: The Security Council paused new Stylus program activations on Arbitrum One and Nova over WebAssembly denial of service risks to liveness. Existing Stylus contracts keep running and no restart date is set

Title: Gap in Arbitrum One data submissions
Detail: ETHBEAT records a liveness anomaly with a gap of 17 minutes 24 seconds in transaction data submissions

Title: Binance hot wallet theft of about $6.36B
Detail: Unauthorized withdrawals across multiple chains followed access to Binance operational infrastructure. About $3B was later frozen and Binance committed to cover all losses

Title: Security Council freezes funds tied to Binance exploit
Detail: ETHBEAT records that the Security Council froze about 74.6M ARB and 8,426 ETH tied to the Binance exploiter

Title: Founder House Singapore awards $300K
Detail: Hosted with Robinhood Chain for 125 founders. Atoma won $60K and Kurtosis $40K, and Robinhood Chain awards went to Hyperloop Finance with $60K and Fables with $30K
